{{Quote|Sir, as the team medic, when it comes to the health of the men, including you, I outrank everyone.|Kix, to Captain Rex|<ref name="deserter" />}}
'''Kix''' was a [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medic]] who served in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Kix participated in a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|hunt]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kix, along with [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], went with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to scour through the planet's wetlands on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] in search for [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] that had been jettisoned from Grievous' crashed [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. When two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] attacked the clones, Rex was shot in the chest. Kix, Jesse and Hardcase took the injured Rex to a nearby [[Lawquane farmstead|homestead]] to recover, while they returned to join Kenobi and his team.

Sometime after Saleucami, Kix joined Rex and the 501st Legion on the planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], where he served as a medic during a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] there. During the initial assault on the native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], Kix and the team served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker, however, was relieved of his duties after General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] arrived, who assumed command of Kix and the 501st Legion on Umbara. During the battle, it was revealed that General Krell was secretly working against the Republic, and so Kix helped in the hunt for, and subsequent apprehension of, the traitorous Jedi.

==Biography==
===Hunt for Grievous===
{{Quote|Wait a minute, those critters are domesticated.''"<br />"''Sir?''"<br />"''I think we're on farmland, and where there is a farm, there is usually a farmer. Let's find his homestead.|Jesse and Kix|<ref name="deserter" />}}
[[File:KixExaminesRex.png|thumb|left|240px|Kix overlooks the injured Rex.]]
The [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medic]] who took the name Kix served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="deserter" /> Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Kix was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="databank" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kix served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|battle]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to jettison from his [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|starship]] and landed on Saleucami's surface. Chasing after Grievous, Kenobi gathered a team of clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]], including Kix, to hunt down the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General on Saleucami.<ref name="deserter" /> The team found the wreckage of Grievous' [[Starship/Legends|ship]],<ref name="Ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}}</ref> and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], told Kenobi that the ship had crashed recently. Kenobi decided to split the group into two teams and ordered [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to find the other missing escape pods with [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] Kix, [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]], and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], while he, Cody, and [[Crys/Legends|Crys]] stayed behind to go through the remains of the crashed ship.<ref name="deserter" />

After mounting separate [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]], Kix's team rode through the wetlands of the planet's surface. Ahead of them, two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] were stationed on top of a hill overlooking the clones. Utilizing a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] shot Rex, knocking the clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] off his speeder. Jesse ordered Kix to turn his BARC around and protect the Captain, while he and Hardcase drove toward the hill from where the shot had been fired. Jesse and Hardcase destroyed the droids while Kix examined Rex's injury, and Kix informed Jesse that Rex's injury was severe. Hardcase told Kix and Jesse that the two droid commandos might have called for backup, and they needed to find shelter for Rex.<ref name="deserter" /> After noticing domesticated [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]],<ref name="Ep guide" /> Jesse concluded that they were on [[Farm/Legends|farmland]], which meant there was a homestead nearby. Kix attached a flatbed onto the side of his BARC speeder and laid Rex on it before the team drove off to find the farmer's homestead.<ref name="deserter" />

Upon arriving at the nearby [[Lawquane farmstead|homestead]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu]], greeted the clones warily, pointing a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] at the intruders. Kix and Jesse informed her that they were friends and they needed a place to settle the injured Rex for the night, and Suu gave the clones permission to use the barn. After Kix placed a [[Bacta patch/Legends|bacta patch]] on Rex's wound, he regained consciousness, and Jesse and the other troopers informed him of what had recently transpired. Kix told Rex that he was in no condition to fight and that he should rest. Before Kix and the team left to continue their search for the escape pods, Rex gave Jesse the responsibility of leading the search party. After the clones boarded their BARC speeders, Kenobi contacted the group via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and called for Rex. Jesse responded and informed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that Rex had been injured, and that the Captain had given him the duty of leading the search for the escape pods. Kenobi told Jesse that Grievous was heading for an abandoned escape pod, and ordered the troopers to drive westward, trapping Grievous between the two squads.<ref name="deserter" />

[[File:Clones_TheDeserter.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Kix (center) and the clones, inside a barn]]
Later, Jesse contacted Kenobi and informed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that Kix and the clone troopers had a visual of the escape pod. Grievous was the first to arrive at the escape pod and Kenobi had already engaged Grievous' forces by the time Jesse's team arrived on their BARC speeders. As Kix, Hardcase and Jesse fired their speeder's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] at Grievous' [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Jesse spotted an approaching Confederate [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the sky and warned Kenobi via comlink. After a clone trooper onboard an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] told Kenobi that the walker's guns were overheated, Kenobi ordered Cody and Jesse to cover him as he raced toward Grievous. Kenobi and Grievous engaged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] as the Confederate [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] approached them, eventually coming to a stop as it hovered above the escape pod. Grievous fired his [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]] at the hull of the shuttle and fled in the vehicle. While Kix remained with Hardcase, Jesse and Cody&mdash;aboard their speeders&mdash;returned to Kenobi after dispatching the remaining battle droids. The Jedi Master told both clone troopers to contact the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and order them to send a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to pick them all up.<ref name="deserter" />

===Service in Torrent Company===
At some point during the war, Kix was [[Battle of Ereesus|stationed]] as part of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] on [[Ereesus]].<ref name="speaking silently">{{InsiderCite|139|"Speaking Silently"|reprint=1}} </ref> {{Expandsect}}

===Umbara Campaign===
{{Quote|Sir, we've been keeping this pace for 12 hours now. The men are getting worn down. We should rest.|Kix to Rex|<ref name="DOU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Republic launched a massive attack on the planet of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Kix served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. However, Skywalker was asked to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and meet Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for an unknown reason; leaving [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] in command of the 501st. As the 501st made their way to the Umbaran capital, Kix notified Rex that the battalion's troopers were getting exhausted. After Rex told Krell, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] told him the clone troopers needed no rest.<ref name="DOU" />

[[File:KixTupInShock-CoK.png|thumb|left|250px|Kix and Tup are shocked to find they've killed their own brothers]]
The clone troopers are hard-pressed in holding their current position under the relentless [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] attacks from the ground and the air, and are unable to break through to support [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi asked General Krell to assault a nearby airbase which is being used as a supply staging area for the capital's defenses. The battalion regroups and proceeds towards the airbase. Citing the urgency of Kenobi's current situation, Krell discards Rex's suggestion to scout for a secure route, ordering the troops to advance along a central gorge, despite Rex's protest that the narrow route will only allow advances by single squads. During the attack on the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] airbase, Kix made an effort to take care of the injured and complained that Krell's plan would result in too many clone casualties. Rex insisted that he could aid the wounded later. After hearing this, Kix told Rex he sounded just like [[General/Legends|General]] Krell.<ref name="TG">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>

When [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and clone trooper [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] betrayed General Krell's order&mdash;to not destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] supply ship&mdash;Kix was one of the troopers that was preparing to execute Fives and Jesse. Like the other clone troopers, he purposely missed them and assisted in the apprehension of [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]]. Kix also took part in the capturing of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] alongside his captain.<ref name="COK">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

===Battle of Kiros===
{{Quote|I need a medic over here!|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>}}
[[File:KixOnKiros-Kidnapped.png|thumb|right|250px|Kix attending to a wounded brother on Kiros]]

Later in the war, Kix was sent to [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] after [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] decided to negotiate with Count Dooku for the welfare of his people. The Republic forces landed on the planet and made their way to the headquarter, however the separatist commander, [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]], planted bombs around the city. After the initial skirmish on Kiros, Jedi master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] received a message from the Separatist commander, the Zygerrian Darts D'Nar, who requested to talk to him alone to discuss the terms of surrender. Believing that D'Nar wanted to surrender, Kenobi went to the governor's tower alone. When Kenobi entered the main room of D'Nar's headquarters, he saw the commander talking to Dooku and the Zygerrian Atai Molec via a holoprojector, assuring them that the situation on the planet was under his control. As Kenobi entered the room, he was taken under guard by two BX-series droid commandos, and Dooku ordered D'Nar to bring the Jedi to him. D'Nar told Kenobi that in fact he wanted the Galactic Republic to surrender, revealing that he had planted thermal detonator bombs throughout the city; D'Nar was intent on activating them and killing everyone if the Republic refused to comply. To prove his point, he ordered the tactical droid, which was also present at the scene, to activate one of the bombs. The bomb detonated near the Republic encampment, injuring a number of clone troopers. A clone trooper was injured, but the trooper was cared for by Kix.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

===Biochip Conspiracy===
{{Quote|So... I guess the 501st are back on Coruscant.''"<br />"''Oh yeah, we just got back from Ringo Vinda; the strangest thing happened out there.|A disguised Fives speaking to Kix|<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>}}
In the latter part of the war, Kix participated in the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]], a military campaign in which the 501st, led by Jedi Master Anakin Skywalker were sent to defeat Separatist forces on a space station surrounding the planet of [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]]. In the midst of battle, clone trooper Tup fired upon, and subsequently killed Jedi General [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]] under mysterious circumstances, forcing the Republic forces to retreat. Upon securing a safe location, they set off to determine why Tup had mercilessly murdered a commander in cold blood. Taking the volatile clone to the side, Rex noted that he had believed Tup had simply snapped, as he began spontaneously repeating that "good soldiers follow orders". Being their medic, Kix began assessing Tup and waved his hand in front of the clone's face. Tup suddenly lashed out forcing Tiplar's sister, [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], to suspend him with use of the force.<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

Following this, Tup was left to rest in a medical bay. Some time later, Kix, Fives, Rex, Tiplee and Anakin returned to check up on his condition. Tup was once again conscious, and was completely unaware of his actions, and upon being informed by Fives, he broke down, denying that it could be possible. As a result of his brash reaction, the medical droid was forced to sedate him. Anakin then asked Kix if he had checked all of Tup's medical scans, to which he replied that from his knowledge, it appeared to be a combat related stress and that he had broken down. Rex and Fives were not convinced however, noting that they as clones were engineered to withstand it. They then quizzed that it could have been the work of biological warfare, and that the enemy had drugged him into killing the Jedi. Kix then came to the conclusion that the only way they could be certain what had happened was to send Tup to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], in order to be fully examined.<ref name="The Unknown" />

Following the events of the Ringo Vinda campaign, the 501st legion returned back to Coruscant. On one of the nights following their arrival, Kix and Jesse were socializing at the clone bar, [[79's/Legends|79's]]. Clone trooper Fives had been framed for attempting to murder [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], after discovering the truth behind the reasoning that Tup had executed Jedi Master Tipar, and while on the run from Republic forces, sought refuge in the bar. Upon entering, he spotted Kix, and followed him into the bathroom. While the clone medic was looking at himself in the mirror, Fives began conversation with him, noting that the 501st were now back on Coruscant. Kix then remarked that a strange occurrence had happened while on Ringo Vinda to, which Fives then revealed himself to him, stating that he knew.<ref name="Orders" />

[[File:Kix_and_fives.png|thumb|left|240px|Fives tells Kix of a terrible conspiracy that reaches to the highest levels of the Republic.]]
Kix was bewildered to see Fives, and told him that rumors had circulated of how he attempted to murder the Chancellor, and that he had been infected with the same virus that Tup had supposedly been infected with. Fives then vaguely told Kix, that the clones, and the Jedi had all been framed, and were all in grave danger. He pleaded that he needed to make contact with Rex or Skywalker immediately, to which Kix gave the advice that Fives should turn himself in. Fives exclaimed that Kix simply didn't understand, and that he had been involved in such a conspiracy that reached the highest levels of the Republic. Fives then gave Kix co-ordinates to send to Rex, and asked for him to tell the captain to meet him there. Kix agreed, and promised to pass them on. The two then parted ways, with Kix wishing him luck with whatever Fives was planning to do.<ref name="Orders" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We gotta get these guys outta here.''"<br />"''Forget it. We have to leave them.''"<br />"''We can't just leave them, sir!''"<br />"''You don't have a choice. That's an order.''"<br />"''You sound like General Krell.''"<br />"''Look Kix, it's more important to save yourself right now. If we survive, you can patch up the wounded later.|Kix and Rex arguing over the injured men|<ref name="TG" />}}
[[File:KixFull-SWE.png|thumb|150px|Clone trooper medic Kix]]
As a trained clone trooper [[Medic/Legends|medic]], Kix believed that when it came to the health of his comrades, he outranked them. Instead of worrying about his enemies, Kix cared more about the welfare and livelihood of his fellow troopers.<ref name="kix" /> During the Battle of Saleucami, Kix respected Rex when the clone told him of how he had been injured after being shot by a commando droid's sniper rifle. He took great concern for Rex's health, and advised Jesse and Hardcase that in order to see the full extent of Rex's injury, he had to remove pieces of Rex's [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. After Rex handed the leading position to Jesse, Kix cooperated with Jesse's orders that were given to himself and Hardcase.<ref name="deserter" />

As a field medic, Kix was equipped with [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], as well as other first-aid commodities, to help fellow injured clone troopers during a battle. The clone trooper also carried a blaster rifle.<ref name="kix" /> On the left side of his head, Kix had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] that read, "A GOOD DROID IS A DEAD ONE," in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Ep guide" /> His [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]] sported light [[blue]] markings.<ref name="deserter" /> After attaining [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] armor, his 501st armor had additional red markings that signified his status as a medic.

==Behind the scenes==
Kix first appeared in "[[The Deserter]]," the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]]. Like all clones in the show, Kix was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Ep guide" />
